sections.indications_and_usage: INDICATIONS For temporary eduction of the symptoms of insomnia.
sections.dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS One tablet three times daily or as directed by a health professional.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: WARNINGS Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Posion Control Center right away. If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Tamper seal: ​sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is broken or missing
